planValue: At Uber, I built an internal AI gateway in Python and FastAPI that routes requests across several model providers, with retries, caching, and structured-output parsing. I also built evaluation pipelines so model changes could be checked against curated examples before reaching production. I’d be glad to discuss how that experience could apply here.
